subject: fix(web): browser page translation no longer crashes the app when a turn updates (#40856)

subject: fix(server): watch_pull_request says when checks already passed (#40866)
reason: mcp/toolkits/pullRequests/handlers.ts uses Cox’s PR summary to report already passing checks and still opens the watch. Cox keeps the watch in the toolkit and has no upstream PullRequestWatchService.ts.

subject: fix(codex): Open diff shows every file of a multi-file patch (#40874)
reason: CodexAdapterV2.ts projects the complete list of files in a native patch item so Open diff can show every changed file.

subject: fix(server): ACP startup gives up when the agent never answers the handshake (#40864)
reason: provider-acp/server/AcpSessionRuntime.ts bounds initialize, session/new and session/resume with the existing typed ACP transport error; the server test uses a live child that reads but never responds.

subject: fix(server): a branch prefixed with another remote's name publishes under its full name (#40877)
reason: GitVcsDriverCore.ts strips only the chosen publishing remote prefix and preserves full local branch names when the upstream is a local branch.

subject: fix(server): list open delegated tasks when task_status or task_cancel finds no match (#40886)
reason: OrchestratorMcpService.ts includes up to ten open tasks from the caller’s thread in status and cancel lookup errors, using the shared local readTask path.

subject: fix(gitlab): find merge requests opened from a fork (#40894)
reason: GitLabSourceControlProvider.ts and gitLabMergeRequests.ts preserve fork owner and branch selectors and deduplicate branch probes; GitLabCli.ts resolves source projects for merge requests returned by glab.

subject: fix(web): pasting a chat message with text and a picture keeps both (#40909)
reason: apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatComposer.tsx attaches images from mixed chat HTML without consuming the text paste. composerAttachmentFiles.ts distinguishes image-only, image-and-text and text-only sources.

subject: fix(antigravity): bound silent post-settle background command holds (#40858)
reason: Cox AntigravityAdapterV2.ts uses ordinary ACP prompt completion and native batch projection, with deferFinalizeForBackgroundWork unset and no toolOutlivesPrompt or wakeOnDetachedRequest hook. The upstream AntigravityChildWork.ts and wake continuation path are absent. Prior audit excludes that feature in 6edb53026b3127fb5d1dcbd207c096b00e1bf880 and 3a917574301e0048b34ff4b4f903e234aa46c4ff.

subject: fix(desktop): WSL is not offered or started when only the Windows install stub exists (#40918)
reason: apps/desktop/src/wsl/DesktopWslEnvironment.ts and its tests are absent. apps/desktop/src/backend.ts starts the official local Cox npm backend, and AGENTS.md scopes desktop to macOS and Windows. Prior audit 905346e0d091bd447eff72d17f1b8296845e0aa2 excluded the WSL-owned backend.

subject: fix(server): idle /ws connections behind a reverse proxy no longer drop every 60s (#40932)
reason: ws.ts writes periodic RPC pong frames after authentication so a reverse proxy sees upstream traffic during idle connections. Cox does not have upstream split frames on this route.

subject: fix(server): thread reads no longer attribute T3 Code's compact-before-send /compact to the user (#40934)
reason: OrchestratorMcpService.ts attributes automatic pre-send compaction to the system and cli/thread.ts displays the corresponding System label.

subject: fix(web,mobile): @-file mentions show by name in message previews, not as raw links (#40924)
reason: packages/shared/src/composerInlineTokens.ts uses composer mention matching and renders basenames in queued and stashed messages, sidebar draft previews and seed titles. The Cox Capacitor client uses the web preview.

subject: fix(web): tool calls stay grouped after a usage-limit pause again (#40905)
reason: apps/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx passes the failed usage-limit run through MessagesTimeline.tsx so MessagesTimeline.logic.ts keeps tools grouped when the recovery notice replaces the error row.
